rate_limits: Free models (:free): 20 RPM / 50 RPD if <10 credits purchased all-time; 20 RPM / 1,000 RPD after ≥10 credits. Account-wide, not per model. Provider-specific and Cloudflare DDoS limits also apply; paid variants have no platform request cap.
